nodes.name: Attach Chunk Metadata

nodes.name: Prepare Documents
nodes.notes: Wraps incoming items as documents (with metadata) for the vector store.

nodes.notes: Chunks documents (~1200 chars, 120 overlap) so retrieval hits stay focused.

nodes.notes: Embedding model — MUST be the same model for indexing and querying, or retrieval quality collapses. Credential: OpenAI API key. Same OpenAI API key as the chat model.

nodes.notes: Collapses all items into a single summary item (for counts and run stats).

# Extract from uploaded files with Google Drive and Google Sheets 24/7

**Pattern:** File Processing · **Level:** Production · **Trigger:** Scheduled

## What it does
Extract from uploaded files with Google Drive and Google Sheets 24/7. It runs automatically on a schedule.

## Why it exists
Manual invoices is slow and error-prone; this workflow makes the process repeatable, monitored and hands-off, with failures surfaced instead of silently lost.

## Main flow
Daily Schedule → List Changed Docs (Google Drive) → Remove Duplicate Documents → Download File Content → Extract Text from File → Attach Chunk Metadata → Insert into Vector Store → …

## Use it for
- Teams that want to file processing without manual effort
- Anyone automating invoices in legal
- Replacing a fragile manual process with a reliable workflow

## You get
- Improves response time
- Saves hours of manual work each week
- Has retries and error handling built in

## Before first run
Connect credentials: Google OAuth2; Google OAuth2 / service account; OpenAI API key; Qdrant URL + key; Slack OAuth2.
Follow the color key: 🟦 entry · 🟪 AI · 🟫 actions · ⬜ utilities · 🟩 outputs · 🟥 error rail.
Each node has its own doc card underneath — read those before editing.

## Try it now
Sample data is pinned on the trigger — hit **Execute Workflow** to watch it flow through every node before connecting any real credentials. Unpin the trigger (right-click → Unpin) when you're ready to go live.

## Design decisions

Ingestion is a separate workflow from querying because indexing and answering have different triggers, schedules, and failure modes — a slow re-index should never block a live user question. Chunking with overlap (not whole documents) keeps each retrieval hit focused on relevant text instead of dragging in an entire document's unrelated sections.

## Practice exercises

Already production-grade — deepen your understanding:

1. Change chunkSize and chunkOverlap, then compare retrieval quality back in the query workflow.
2. Add a second file source and normalize both into the same chunk-metadata shape.
3. Swap the embedding model — but change it in both this workflow and the query workflow, since they must match.

## Credentials setup

Credentials are never included in a template file, so every node below needs its own connection before the first real run. In n8n: open the node, click the Credential dropdown, choose **Create new**.

**Google OAuth2**
Google Cloud Console → enable Drive API → OAuth2 client or Service Account.
_Gotcha:_ Service Accounts have their own empty Drive — share the target folder with it.

**Qdrant URL + key**
Qdrant Cloud → cluster URL + API key (or your self-hosted URL).
_Gotcha:_ Create the collection with the right vector size before inserting.

**OpenAI API key**
Same OpenAI API key as the chat model.
_Gotcha:_ Indexing and querying MUST use the same embedding model or retrieval breaks.

**Google OAuth2 / service account**
Google Cloud Console → enable Sheets API → OAuth2 client, or a Service Account.
_Gotcha:_ Using a Service Account? Share the spreadsheet with its email address or it 404s.

**Slack OAuth2**
Slack API → Your Apps → create an app → OAuth & Permissions. n8n's Slack OAuth2 credential walks the install for you.
_Gotcha:_ Needs `chat:write`. Invite the bot to the channel or posting fails with `not_in_channel`.

Set each credential up once and it is reusable across every workflow in your instance.

## Troubleshooting

**Workflow does nothing when the trigger should fire**
Cause: It is still a draft, or the trigger is inactive.
Fix: Publish/activate the workflow. Manual test runs use a different URL than production.

**A node shows a red error triangle on import**
Cause: No credential is attached yet.
Fix: Expected on a fresh import — open the node and attach a credential (see the Credentials setup note).

**Retrieval returns nothing or irrelevant chunks**
Cause: Index is empty, or indexing and querying used different embedding models.
Fix: Run the ingestion workflow first, and make sure both sides use the identical embedding model.

Still stuck? n8n's **Executions** tab shows the exact node that failed and the data going into it — start there rather than guessing.

## 🛟 Error handling & retries

External calls retry **3× with 2s backoff**. Anything still failing exits through its node's error output into the red error rail → context is captured and the on-call channel is alerted. Failures are also parked in a dead-letter queue for replay. Set an n8n **Error Workflow** in settings as the final safety net.

## 🤖 AI cluster

Purple nodes form one AI unit: the root node orchestrates, sub-nodes plug in via typed ports (model / memory / tools / parser). Swap the chat model without rewiring anything else. Costs scale with tokens — keep prompts lean and cap iterations.

## 🧹 Data quality

Dedupe/diff steps make re-runs safe: the same input twice will not create duplicate records. If you change the key fields, clear n8n's dedupe memory (node → 'Clear stored keys') before the next run.

## 🛠 Customize me

Quick wins: point the data nodes at your own accounts (see 🔑 lines on each card), adjust the trigger cadence, and tune thresholds/labels to your invoices process. Every node card explains its role — safe to extend at any marked branch.
